name: desktop
title: Desktop
description: A whole site as a Mac OS X 10.1 desktop, from a Site (lib/content.ts): the Finder in three views with a Kind filter, marquee, search and Back; TextEdit documents with an outline; Preview and QuickTime windows; the About box with its panes; the menu bar, desktop icons and Dock — every window dragged, resized, zoomed and minimised through the genie.

files.content:
/**
 * The desktop's own icons: Olivia's own artwork (apps/web/public/icons/), 128px on the
 * longer side, as near-lossless WebP, inlined as data URIs so they install
 * with the source.
 * Generated by scripts/desktop-icons.mjs — edit the pictures and run it again.
 */

export const FINDER = "data:image/webp;base64,"
export const DISK = "data:image/webp;base64,"
export const NOTE = "data:image/webp;base64,"
export const IPOD = "data:image/webp;base64,"

/**
 * Patina OS, as every desktop built with it names it: in the ★ menu's
 * About Patina OS, on About The Finder, in the page's generator tag and
 * once in the browser's console. The version is the pack's own: it is
 * bumped with every release, with the CLI's.
 */
export const PATINA = {
  name: "Patina OS",
  version: "0.4.8",
  taste: "Aqua × millennium",
  by: "Olivia Forster",
  site: "https://oliviaforster.com",
  source: "https://github.com/livisliving/Patina",
} as const
